scope: Theorem 8.11 (Charge budget) of the manuscript “Self-dual random-cluster interfaces below one” (preprints/Self-dual-random-cluster-interfaces-below-one-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 bf15a86507a10184), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 136. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For any fixed finite list of charges satisfying aj > 0, (1 + aj)λ < π/2, X j aj = 1, for every η > 0 there is Cη,a < ∞ such that the local costs obey P + D∗ + X j log F−(aj) F+(aj) ≤ η log n + Cη,a. (8.55) The assertion is valid for either global wire designation, with the fixed buffered cutoff conventions just specified. Equivalently, the left side has the one-sided o(log n) allowance defined above.
